cases.skipped: Each case filters a chart down to one visible series while its title stays absent (no c:title, autoTitleDeleted=0). On re-save Excel adds an automatic c:title to some such charts and not to others with the same part structure (it does for line_standard, not for line_markers), so the re-saved title kind does not follow from the file. Every other formatting value in these cases reads back as Formulon wrote it. Same behaviour as chart_absent_title_display_undetermined.
